host_regression_before_fix: IllegalStateException: four retained candidate bundles maximum
host_scope: production file/hash/retention code with narrow JSON, model and AtomicFile stand-ins; not Android JSON validation or AtomicFile recovery
retention: four sha-named base files; validate digest/protocol before removing oldest, preserve idempotent target
limitations: pruning before write can lose an old inactive candidate if subsequent write fails
backup-only crash remnants and Android recovery not covered
immutable registry snapshots and Cold/Warm model lifecycle are independent
